note: Re-judged 2026-09-29 (independent judge). TestRFC4552EveryStateSharesSPIAndKeys builds the ESP interface's whole SA set (inbound unicast plus the two bidirectional multicast states) and asserts every state carries the one configured SPI and byte-identical integrity and encryption keys; the second half configures another SPI and other keys and finds those on every state, which refuses keys not taken from manual configuration. Records on buildIPsecInterfaceSAs and buildIPsecSA. The stale {single-polarity} annotation was removed from the row by the judge (./le rfc check demanded it). Not driven: the per-neighbour outbound unicast state (onNeighborSeen), which calls the same buildIPsecSA with the same spec.
